response.original_title: Filme do Comício de Faro – Luar
response.overview: It is an incomplete segment of a larger project—the script of which is known. The footage corresponds to the rushes filmed at the time. It is associated with the most militant phase of her work, featuring a recording of a LUAR rally in the Algarve and interviews conducted by Noémia with residents of shantytowns—though the audio for these interviews is missing.
